integrity_notes: The proof is symbolic and is supported by an exact-rational verification script. Literature searches do not establish exhaustive uniqueness; an unindexed erratum or correspondence remains possible.
scientific_limitations: The conclusion is for the unconstrained quadratic quasi-linear consumer problem implicit in the inverse-demand first-order conditions and is limited to the branch 2+(n-1)gamma<0. A finite-budget or capped-numeraire variant is not covered; formal best-response dynamics with exogenous inverse demand remain algebraically meaningful.
title: Strong complements invalidate the stated consumer-choice microfoundation
